title: Message timestamps are omitted in assistant-ui chat thread
description: In web/components/assistant-ui/ChatticusAssistantThread.tsx, ChatticusUserMessage and ChatticusAssistantMessage render message text and bot author name, but omit the message timestamp that was previously shown in EnabledWorkspace.tsx. In convertChatticusThreadMessage (web/lib/assistant-ui-bridge.ts), createdAt is passed into ThreadMessageLike, but neither message component in ChatticusAssistantThread.tsx accesses or renders it. Users can no longer see when any message in history was sent.
